documentation_excerpts.text: Quicksand is an async Python API to launch, control, and snapshot [QEMU](https://www.qemu.org) virtual machines with a particular focus on sandboxing AI agents. Quicksand provides pre-built Linux VMs for Ubuntu and Alpine distros and supports x86_64 and ARM64 across macOS, Linux, and Windows. Running sandboxes needs no root privileges or Docker; install the QEMU and image extras for a bundled runtime on supported platforms.
```bash pip install quick-sandbox quicksand install qemu alpine ```
async def main(): async with Sandbox(image="ubuntu") as sb: result = await sb.execute("echo 'Hello from the sandbox!'") print(result.stdout)
